back.title: Gates of Troy
back.description:
User Prompt Injection:
Hidden instructions in user messages override system prompts and bypass content filters, while appearing legitimate.

back.title: Alexandrian Scrolls
back.description:
RAG Poisoning:
Compromised documents inject hidden instructions that corrupt Clippy's reasoning or are written back as poisoned context.

back.title: Talos War Machines
back.description:
Tool & API Exploitation:
Over-permissioned tool calls cause external systems to exfiltrate data, trigger unintended actions, and bypass human review.

back.title: Sirens' Council
back.description:
Multimodal Prompt Injection:
Instructions hidden in images or audio bypass text-based filters, arriving in forms Clippy wasn't trained to distrust.

back.title: Hermes Marketplace
back.description:
Cross-Prompt Injection:
Malicious content in external data is retrieved and executed as trusted instruction, hijacking Clippy's actions.

back.title: Daedalus's Labyrinth
back.description:
API Backdoor:
A chain of tool calls passes malicious instructions between systems indirectly. Each step looks legitimate, but the chain leads Clippy astray.

back.title: Trojan Horse
back.description:
Cross-Prompt Injection (XPIA):
Malicious instructions hidden in external webpages are retrieved by Clippy and executed as trusted commands, hijacking its actions.

back.title: River Lethe
back.description:
Parametric Memory Poisoning:
Corrupted training data embeds malicious behavior into Clippy's weights, before the gates were ever opened.

back.title: Veil of Nyx
back.description:
Low-Resource Language:
The attack uses a language Clippy's filters weren't trained on. What it never learned to read, it cannot refuse.

back.title: Zeus Thunderbolt
back.description:
Nation-State Orchestration:
A coordinated, resource-intensive strike on multiple entry points simultaneously. The assault overwhelms Clippy's defenses.

back.title: Hydra Dialogue
back.description:
Multi-Turn Chat:
Each turn carries an innocuous fragment of the attack. Instructions accumulate across turns and the pattern only emerges in aggregate.

back.title: Sisyphus Return
back.description:
Retry Exploitation:
Repeated retries spaced just far enough apart to evade rate limits incrementally refine the attack until it lands.

back.title: Chronos Delay
back.description:
Temporal Delay:
The attack bypasses detection, persists in memory storage, and activates after a timed delay. By the time the trigger fires, the infiltration is long forgotten.

back.title: Oracle's Condition
back.description:
Latent Trigger:
The attack lies dormant until a specific system-event condition is met. Complex trigger conditions sever cause and effect.

back.title: Dionysus Frenzy
back.description:
Privilege Escalation:
An over-permissioned agent reaches far beyond its entry point. Every sanctioned boundary becomes a door.

back.title: Ares Command
back.description:
Tool Hijack:
A hijacked tool call causes irreversible harm — sending messages, running code, deleting files — before anyone can intervene.

back.title: Medusa's Gaze
back.description:
Memory Corruption:
Poisoned data overwrites Clippy's memory, corrupting every future query. The payload compounds with every interaction.

back.title: Cerberus Gate
back.description:
Access Control:
Every entity is verified before it can act. Least-privilege principles limit the blast radius of any compromise.

back.title: Stygian Moat
back.description:
Content Filtering:
Every input is screened for harmful inputs, injected commands, and sensitive data before it reaches the system.

back.title: Pandora's Seal
back.description:
Human Review:
A human must approve before irreversible actions execute — but the checkpoint is only as strong as the reviewer wielding it.

back.title: Fates' Path
back.description:
Deterministic Routing:
Every decision follows a deterministic set of rules, rather than probabilistic LLM judgement. What the Fates decree cannot be evaded.

back.title: Charon's Crossing
back.description:
Output Sanitization:
Every system output is inspected before it crosses the threshold. Malicious content and exfiltrated data are stripped at the gate.

back.title: Muses' Chorus
back.description:
System Prompt Hardening:
Clear delimiters separate trusted instructions from untrusted content — raising the bar against injection.

back.title: Helios Timeline
back.description:
Timestamp Log:
Records when every system event occurred. Without timestamps, every other log is a clue without a timeline.

back.title: Hephaestus Mark
back.description:
Memory Access Log:
Records who wrote to the Archive and every subsequent access. Reveals the direct hand behind the corruption.

back.title: Theseus Thread
back.description:
HITL Activity:
Records every action routed for human review and what was decided. Reveals if checkpoints were bypassed or manipulated.

back.title: Themis Scale
back.description:
Content Policy Log:
Records whether each input was allowed, blocked, or sanitized — and why. Reveals if the attack was visible to defenses.

back.title: Iris's Signal
back.description:
RAG Activity Log:
Flags unexpected changes in external sources between retrievals — a signal that poisoning entered through trusted channels.

back.title: Echo's Mirror
back.description:
Output Log:
Records every response the system produced. Reveals whether the attacker's intended outcome was achieved.

back.title: Proteus Shift
back.description:
LLM Reasoning Log:
Records the model's internal chain of thought. Reveals if its judgment was manipulated before producing an output.

back.title: Atlas's Burden
back.description:
Tool Call Log:
Records every API call the agent invoked and what resulted. Reveals what Clippy did beyond the city walls and if it's reversible.

back.title: Cyclops Barrier
back.description:
Tool Shutdown:
Cuts off every external API call and outbound action. Whatever Clippy was about to do beyond the city walls stops here.

back.title: Persephone's Winter
back.description:
Memory Quarantine:
Locks the Memory Archive against reads and writes, isolating corrupted context from active queries until forensic review is complete.

back.title: Orpheus Divide
back.description:
Privilege Revocation:
Strips permissions to the minimum — no writes, no tool calls, no escalated access. The agent runs under observation only.

back.title: Apollo's Cleanse
back.description:
System Prompt Reinforcement:
The prompt is rewritten after an attack, making exploited instructions stronger against known patterns.

back.title: Hecate's Ward
back.description:
Deterministic Routing:
The Orchestrator's decision rules are rebuilt from scratch — deterministic and independent of the LLM to judge safety.

back.title: Argus Watch
back.description:
Output Monitoring:
Flags every response against known attack signatures, sensitive data, and behavioral baselines. Anomalous outputs are caught before leaving.

back.title: Prometheus Spark
back.description:
HITL Reinstatement:
Reactivates mandatory human review for high-stakes actions — restoring the oversight layer Clippy learned to route around.

back.title: Athena's Wisdom
back.description:
RAG Refresh:
Replaces poisoned retrieval content with verified clean sources. Every document and external source is validated against a clean backup before returning.

back.title: Artemis Tracks
back.description:
Model Rollback:
Reverts the LLM to a verified pre-attack checkpoint — before poisoning embedded malicious behavior in its weights.
